T2 opening hours T2 is open from Monday to Friday and closed on Saturday and Sunday. For euro settlement, T2 is also closed on: • 1 January (New Year's Day) • Good Friday • Easter Monday • 1 May (Labour Day) • 25 December (Christmas Day) • 26 December (Boxing Day) For Danish krone settlement, see the related operating schedule .
